story.photoAlt: Placeholder photo standing in for a portrait of Priya Anand in her home kitchen
story.story: I started Goldenrod Kitchen in my own kitchen five years ago, baking one loaf of sourdough a week for neighbors who asked nicely. I had spent a decade in restaurant kitchens before that, and what I wanted most was to cook the way I actually eat: seasonal, unfussy, made from scratch, and shared around a table. Today I still bake and cook everything myself, in small batches, using a state approved home kitchen and local ingredients whenever I can find them. If you order from Goldenrod Kitchen, you are getting food I would serve my own family, made by the same two hands every time.
